messages:
sam: Quick design check 1 experimenting with a compact inline create row for API creds + an inline soft-revoke banner (undoable). Mock: https://staging.redwood.local/mock/compact-inline-2256789012.png

maria: Compact create looks nice. Concern: will non-admins understand scopes inline? Suggest a small 'About scopes' link next to the CTA. :thinking_face:

lee: Engineering: inline is fine. Do NOT fetch full org-scope matrix on page load  lazy-load when scope picker opens. Revoke should be idempotent; return a job_id and support optimistic UI with "Revoking..." state.

ada: A11y: scope picker must be a real combobox (aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant). Soft-revoke banner should announce via aria-live="polite" and final revoke via role="status" + aria-live="assertive". Provide explicit aria-labels for Undo/Delete.

sam: UX idea: click Revoke -> row collapses to amber inline banner "Key revoked  Restore | Delete permanently". No blocking modal. Microcopy vote: A) "Key revoked  Restore" B) "Revoked  Delete permanently". I prefer A.

maria: +1 A. Also add helper text under create CTA: "Keys scoped by role. Admins can rotate/limit later." Might reduce broad-scope errors.

lee: Backend: protect against double revokes by returning 409 if job already exists. UI should disable revoke button until job response. On failure revert and show inline error with retry.

ada: For keyboard users, ensure when the row collapses focus moves to the banner's primary action. Announce collapse with aria-live so SR users know they can Undo. Also ensure the undo window is keyboard-accessible before it auto-dismisses.

sam: Action items: (1) I'll update mock + Loom of keyboard nav. (2) @lee add lazy-load + revoke job contract to API spec. (3) @ada write a11y acceptance criteria. (4) @maria finalize microcopy.

ci-bot: sam opened branch feat/creds-compact-inline-2256789012  CI: green, preview: https://staging.redwood.local/preview/creds-compact-inline-2256789012

maria: I'll draft a short UX spec and propose a small A/B test (2.5% of orgs) for compact vs modal. If metrics look good we can roll out.

sam: Thanks all  will post updated PNG and aria snippets later today.
